reviewNotes.1989: Parallel-bar stretch shows both feet grounded, hips flexed, straight arms and hands on separate bars. Visible radial muscle-like lines in the tank overlay require correction. Qualified review also needed for chest-drop range and bar height.

reviewNotes.1991: Original master unexpectedly contains two similar figures. Preserve the entire original and deliver only the right-hand final static hold using normalized crop bounds. Rear torso, pelvis and feet are coherent; lower working arm holds the towel behind the back, overhead assisting hand holds its upper end, and posterior-deltoid highlight follows the working side. Qualified review needed for internal-rotation range, wrist and towel contact, and muscle mapping.
reviewNotes.1992: Two distinct hack-squat positions show high and lowered sled carriage, supported back and shoulders, hands on handles, and feet on the platform. Qualified review required for exact below-parallel depth, knee tracking, heel contact, carriage/rail mechanics and quadriceps mapping.
